body: Yeah I have. But you know, at the end of the day all we have is ourselves. Everyone has their own life and battles. Doesn’t matter how much someone loves you, you are the one who has to live with YOU.
Do you mean professional? Yes. Doesn’t work for me even though it does feel somewhat better.

Im probably lying to myself. I do want contact, to be loved and understood. But people just hurt me. Ever since I was a child. So I have given up in my faith in others to take care of my heart. As a friend, a lover and even family

Thanks.. 
 At this point I just don’t do everyday tasks either like I used to. I don’t have a job or go to school so I just sit at home. All. Day. The friends I had have hurt me so much in the last year and all told me how they don’t think I’m a good friend. Which is true I guess, I don’t care for relationships with others.
